ayahs.translation_bn: অধিক (পার্থিব) সুখ সম্ভোগ লাভের মোহ তোমাদেরকে (অধিক গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় হতে) ভুলিয়ে রেখেছে।
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ل-ه-و (l-h-w): cognitive distraction; ك-ث-ر (k-th-r): consumerist quantitative hoarding.
ayahs.conventional_bn: অধিক (পার্থিব) সুখ সম্ভোগ লাভের মোহ তোমাদেরকে (অধিক গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় হতে) ভুলিয়ে রেখেছে।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ل-ه-و (l-h-w): cognitive distraction; ك-ث-ر (k-th-r): consumerist quantitative hoarding.

english_translations.pickthall: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
english_translations.yusuf_ali: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: The desire to have more of the worldly gains have pre-occupied you so much (that you have neglected remembring God),
english_translations.mohsin_khan: The mutual rivalry for piling up of worldly things diverts you,

ayahs.translation_bn: এমনকি (এ অবস্থাতেই) তোমরা কবরে এসে পড়।
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ز-و-ر (z-w-r): transient visit to graves prior to final resurrection; ق-ب-ر (q-b-r): burial sites.
ayahs.conventional_bn: এমনকি (এ অবস্থাতেই) তোমরা কবরে এসে পড়।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ز-و-ر (z-w-r): transient visit to graves prior to final resurrection; ق-ب-ر (q-b-r): burial sites.

english_translations.pickthall: Until ye come to the graves.
english_translations.shakir: Until you come to the graves.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: until you come to the graves.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Until you visit the graves (i.e. till you die).
english_translations.arberry: even till you visit the tombs.

ayahs.translation_bn: (তোমরা যে ভুল ধারণায় ডুবে আছো তা) মোটেই ঠিক নয়, শীঘ্রই তোমরা জানতে পারবে,
ayahs.translation_en: No! You are going to know.
ayahs.conventional_en: No! You are going to know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: (তোমরা যে ভুল ধারণায় ডুবে আছো তা) মোটেই ঠিক নয়, শীঘ্রই তোমরা জানতে পারবে,

english_translations.sahih_international: No! You are going to know.
english_translations.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Nay! You shall come to know!
english_translations.arberry: No indeed; but soon you shall know.

ayahs.translation_bn: আবার বলি, মোটেই ঠিক নয়, শীঘ্রই তোমরা জানতে পারবে।
ayahs.translation_en: Then no! You are going to know.
ayahs.conventional_en: Then no! You are going to know.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আবার বলি, মোটেই ঠিক নয়, শীঘ্রই তোমরা জানতে পারবে।

english_translations.sahih_international: Then no! You are going to know.
english_translations.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
english_translations.shakir: Nay! Nay! you shall soon know.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: You shall cetainly know (about the consequences of your deeds).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Again, Nay! You shall come to know!
english_translations.arberry: Again, no indeed; but soon you shall know.

ayahs.translation_bn: কক্ষনো না, তোমরা যদি নিশ্চিত জ্ঞানের ভিত্তিতে জানতে! (তাহলে সাবধান হয়ে যেতে)
ayahs.translation_en: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
ayahs.conventional_en: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
ayahs.meta_bn: অবজেক্টিভ ডেটা ভেরিফিকেশন বা ইলমুল ইয়াকীন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ‘Ilm al-Yaqīn: theoretical, deductive and evidential certainty of absolute truth.
ayahs.conventional_bn: কক্ষনো না, তোমরা যদি নিশ্চিত জ্ঞানের ভিত্তিতে জানতে! (তাহলে সাবধান হয়ে যেতে)

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: ‘Ilm al-Yaqīn: theoretical, deductive and evidential certainty of absolute truth.

english_translations.sahih_international: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
english_translations.pickthall: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
english_translations.shakir: Nay! if you had known with a certain knowledge,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: You will certainly have the knowledge of your deeds beyond all doubt.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge (the end result of piling up, you would not have occupied yourselves in worldly things)
english_translations.arberry: No indeed; did you know with the knowledge of certainty,

ayahs.translation_bn: তোমরা অবশ্য অবশ্যই জাহান্নাম দেখতে পাবে,
ayahs.translation_en: You will surely see the Hellfire.
ayahs.conventional_en: You will surely see the Hellfire.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ر-أ-ي (r-'-y): visual empirical perception of Hellfire.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তোমরা অবশ্য অবশ্যই জাহান্নাম দেখতে পাবে,

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ر-أ-ي (r-'-y): visual empirical perception of Hellfire.

english_translations.sahih_international: You will surely see the Hellfire.
english_translations.shakir: You should most certainly have seen the hell;
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, You shall see the blazing Fire (Hell)!

ayahs.translation_bn: আবার বলি, তোমরা তা অবশ্য অবশ্যই দিব্য দৃষ্টিতে দেখতে পাবে,
ayahs.translation_en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
ayahs.conventional_en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
ayahs.meta_bn: লাইভ অপ্টিক্যাল ভেরিফিকেশন বা আইনুল ইয়াকীন
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: ‘Ayn al-Yaqīn: sensory, direct visual empirical verification.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আবার বলি, তোমরা তা অবশ্য অবশ্যই দিব্য দৃষ্টিতে দেখতে পাবে,

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: ‘Ayn al-Yaqīn: sensory, direct visual empirical verification.

english_translations.sahih_international: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
english_translations.pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
english_translations.shakir: Then you shall most certainly see it with the eye of certainty;
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and you will see it with your own eyes.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!
english_translations.arberry: Again, you shall surely see it with the eye of certainty

ayahs.translation_bn: তারপর তোমাদেরকে অবশ্য অবশ্যই (যা কিছু দেয়া হয়েছে এমন সব) নি‘মাত সম্পর্কে সেদিন জিজ্ঞেস করা হবে।
ayahs.translation_en: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
ayahs.conventional_en: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root س-أ-ল (s-'-l): quantitative audit; ن-ع-ম (n-'-m): cognitive faculties, health, sustenance, and ecological privileges.
ayahs.conventional_bn: তারপর তোমাদেরকে অবশ্য অবশ্যই (যা কিছু দেয়া হয়েছে এমন সব) নি‘মাত সম্পর্কে সেদিন জিজ্ঞেস করা হবে।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root س-أ-ল (s-'-l): quantitative audit; ن-ع-ম (n-'-m): cognitive faculties, health, sustenance, and ecological privileges.

english_translations.sahih_international: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
english_translations.pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
english_translations.shakir: Then on that day you shall most certainly be questioned about the boons.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Then, on that day, you will be questioned about the bounties (of God).
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Then, on that Day, you shall be asked about the delight (you indulged in, in this world)!
english_translations.arberry: then you shall be questioned that day concerning true bliss.
